name: Runoff
reason: We had a decent soaking, about 50 mm over two weeks with one heavy day, so some litter and fertilizer likely washed in and mid-July heat could set a bloom going, but one big rain isn't a flood.
evidence: rain_last_14d_mm: 50.8 is a moderate wetting, enough to move some nutrients off the fields
